title: PPC Agency - Google Ads Agency, Adwords Cork Wexford & Kerry

facts.fact: ePresence describes itself as a Certified Google Partner offering PPC services in Cork.
facts.quote: Grow your business the smart way with our specialist PPC agency in Cork which is a Certified Google Partner.

facts.fact: ePresence states that its team is Google AdWords and Analytics certified.
facts.quote: In fact, our dedicated team are Google AdWordsand Analytics certified.

facts.fact: ePresence states that it creates and manages data-driven PPC campaigns for companies across Cork and Ireland.
facts.quote: We create and manage data-driven PPC campaigns for all types of companies across Cork and Ireland.

facts.fact: ePresence states that display ads are available in three formats: image ads, Gmail advertising, and responsive ads.
facts.quote: Available in three formats (image ads, Gmail advertising, and responsive ads)

facts.fact: ePresence states that more than one billion hours of videos are watched by 122 million people every day on YouTube.
facts.quote: More than one billion hours worth of videos are watched by 122 million people every day on YouTube.

facts.fact: ePresence states that PPC audits can be run as a quarterly check-up or when a new agency takes over a business's PPC management.
facts.quote: They can be run as a quarterly check-up or when a new agency takes over a business's PPC management.

facts.fact: ePresence's portfolio page lists nine sample client projects, including East Cork Oil.
The vendor describes pay-per-click advertising as a marketing channel that lets advertisers pay only when someone clicks on their advert.
facts.quote: Pay-per-click (PPC) advertising is a marketing channel that allows you to pay only when someone clicks on your advert.

facts.fact: A client testimonial from St. Michael's Credit Union says it had used ePresence for almost 2 years at the time of the testimonial.
facts.quote: We have used ePresence for almost 2 years now.

facts.fact: A client testimonial from Rebecca Walsh of Aura Holohan Group says ePresence has managed digital advertising for 3 of the client's brands for a number of years.
facts.quote: Declan has manged the Digital advertising for 3 of our brands for a number of years now

facts.fact: ePresence recommends a minimum PPC ad spend of at least €250 (excluding VAT) per month for local campaigns.
facts.quote: We recommend that for local campaigns a spend of at least €250 (excl. vat) per month.

facts.fact: ePresence recommends spending more than the local minimum for national and international PPC campaigns, without giving a specific figure.
facts.quote: For national and international campaigns, we recommend spending more.

facts.fact: According to ePresence, PPC ad spend is set as a monthly budget and reviewed based on goals.
facts.quote: Ad spend is set as a monthly budget and reviewed based on your goals.

facts.fact: According to ePresence, the cost of PPC advertising depends on the number of clicks on the ad, and advertisers are only charged when the ad is clicked.
facts.quote: The cost of PPC advertising is dependent on the number of times people click on your ad. You are only charged when the ad is clicked on.

facts.fact: ePresence states that a PPC campaign budget can be increased or decreased at any time, which it describes as valuable for seasonal businesses.
facts.quote: This budget can be increased and decreased at any time—a valuable benefit for seasonal businesses.

facts.fact: ePresence describes Google Ads as the most popular PPC tool currently available.
facts.quote: The most popular PPC tool currently available is Google Ads.

facts.fact: PPC ads can target people by location, age, gender and interests, according to ePresence.
facts.quote: You can target specific audiences based on location, age, gender & interests.

facts.fact: PPC ads can target people searching for keywords relevant to the business, according to ePresence.
facts.quote: You can target people searching for relevant keywords to your business.

facts.fact: PPC is defined as 'Pay Per Click', a form of digital marketing advertising that lets businesses buy website traffic.
facts.quote: PPC advertising refers to ‘Pay Per Click’ a form of advertising used in digital marketing campaigns.
